destination_translations.headline: Village life and the landscapes of La Tatacoa
destination_translations.intro: A shaded square, fossil heritage and sculpted earth: Villavieja connects everyday life in northern Huila with La Tatacoa and its astronomy activities.
destination_translations.meta_description: Explore Villavieja, Huila: La Tatacoa, the Paleontological Museum, Santa Bárbara Chapel and astronomy activities.

destination_translations.headline: Entre el pueblo y La Tatacoa
destination_translations.intro: Una plaza de sombra, memoria fósil y paisajes de tierra esculpida: Villavieja conecta la vida del norte del Huila con La Tatacoa y sus noches de observación astronómica.
destination_translations.meta_description: Descubre Villavieja, Huila: La Tatacoa, el Museo Paleontológico, la Capilla de Santa Bárbara y la observación astronómica.

destination_translations.headline: Entre a cidade e as paisagens de La Tatacoa
destination_translations.intro: Uma praça arborizada, memória fóssil e paisagens de terra esculpida: Villavieja conecta a vida do norte de Huila a La Tatacoa e às atividades de observação astronômica.
destination_translations.meta_description: Conheça Villavieja, Huila: La Tatacoa, o Museu Paleontológico, a Capela de Santa Bárbara e a observação astronômica.

destination_story_translations.body: Villavieja is part of the settlement history of the upper Magdalena valley. Its centre preserves Santa Bárbara Chapel and the former parish house, home to the Paleontological Museum.
Villavieja forma parte de la historia del poblamiento del valle alto del Magdalena. Su centro conserva la capilla de Santa Bárbara y la antigua casa cural, donde se encuentra el Museo Paleontológico.
Villavieja faz parte da história de ocupação do vale superior do Magdalena. Seu centro preserva a Capela de Santa Bárbara e a antiga casa paroquial, onde funciona o Museu Paleontológico.

Fossils from La Tatacoa reveal environments very different from today’s dry landscape and help researchers understand Miocene wildlife. The municipality now brings together heritage, research and nature tourism.

La Tatacoa revela un pasado muy distinto del paisaje seco actual: sus fósiles permiten estudiar la fauna y los ambientes del Mioceno. Hoy el municipio reúne patrimonio, investigación y turismo de naturaleza.
Os fósseis de La Tatacoa revelam ambientes muito diferentes da paisagem seca atual e ajudam a compreender a fauna do Mioceno. Hoje o município reúne patrimônio, pesquisa e turismo de natureza.

destination_reason_translations.body: Discover the red and pale eroded formations of La Tatacoa.
Reconocer los relieves rojizos y claros de La Tatacoa.
Conhecer as formações avermelhadas e claras de La Tatacoa.
Explore the village’s fossil and architectural heritage.
Acercarse al patrimonio paleontológico y arquitectónico del pueblo.
Explorar o patrimônio paleontológico e arquitetônico da cidade.
Join organised astronomy sessions, subject to scheduling and sky conditions.

point_of_interest_translations.name: La Tatacoa
point_of_interest_translations.description: This dry landscape combines red gullies around Cuzco with pale formations in Los Hoyos. Follow designated trails and protect its fossil heritage.

point_of_interest_translations.name: La Tatacoa
point_of_interest_translations.description: El paisaje seco de cárcavas y laberintos combina tonos rojizos en Cuzco y formaciones claras en Los Hoyos. Recorre senderos habilitados y protege su patrimonio fósil.

point_of_interest_translations.name: La Tatacoa
point_of_interest_translations.description: A paisagem seca combina ravinas avermelhadas em Cuzco e formações claras em Los Hoyos. Siga as trilhas autorizadas e proteja o patrimônio fóssil.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Villavieja Paleontological Museum
point_of_interest_translations.description: In the village centre, its fossil collection introduces the region’s Miocene animals and environments.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Museo Paleontológico de Villavieja
point_of_interest_translations.description: En el centro del pueblo, su colección permite conocer animales y ambientes del Mioceno a partir de fósiles hallados en la región.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Museu Paleontológico de Villavieja
point_of_interest_translations.description: No centro da cidade, a coleção de fósseis apresenta animais e ambientes do Mioceno encontrados na região.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Santa Bárbara Chapel
point_of_interest_translations.description: This small heritage chapel preserves a simple white façade and a two-bell gable near Villavieja’s historic centre.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Capilla de Santa Bárbara
point_of_interest_translations.description: Esta pequeña capilla patrimonial conserva una fachada sobria de muros blancos y espadaña de dos campanas, junto al centro histórico de Villavieja.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Capela de Santa Bárbara
point_of_interest_translations.description: Esta pequena capela histórica conserva a fachada branca e a espadaña com dois sinos, junto ao centro histórico de Villavieja.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Astronomy in La Tatacoa
point_of_interest_translations.description: Organised talks and telescope observation sessions. Schedules and visible objects depend on the offering and sky conditions.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Observación astronómica en La Tatacoa
point_of_interest_translations.description: Sesiones organizadas de divulgación y observación con telescopios. La programación y lo que puede observarse dependen de la oferta y las condiciones del cielo.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Observação astronômica em La Tatacoa
point_of_interest_translations.description: Sessões organizadas de divulgação e observação com telescópios. A programação e os objetos visíveis dependem da oferta e das condições do céu.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Guided tour of La Tatacoa
point_of_interest_translations.description: An accompanied tour of La Tatacoa’s landscapes and trails. Confirm the booking, itinerary, transport and trail conditions with the provider before setting out.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Recorrido guiado por La Tatacoa
point_of_interest_translations.description: Un recorrido acompañado para conocer los paisajes y senderos de La Tatacoa. Confirma con el prestador la reserva, el itinerario, el transporte y las condiciones del terreno antes de salir.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Passeio guiado por La Tatacoa
point_of_interest_translations.description: Um passeio acompanhado para conhecer as paisagens e trilhas de La Tatacoa. Confirme com o prestador a reserva, o roteiro, o transporte e as condições do terreno antes de sair.
